ei.title: 수능유형픽 독해기본 미니테스트 MT2-1번 (social proof / 함축의미)
ei.subject: 수능유형픽독해기본

fullPassage: Imagine you're trying to decide which of three laptops to purchase online. The first has many reviews and a high rating; the second has fewer reviews and a low rating; and the third has no reviews at all. Chances are that you will select the one with the most satisfied customers. This is due to something called social proof, a psychological phenomenon based on the idea that people strive to conform to social norms. Marketers use it to more or less borrow third-party influence in the interest of luring new customers. Shoppers who are undecided about which product to buy are easily swayed by the reviews and recommendations of other people who have bought the items they are considering. This is why companies are so eager to persuade their customers to leave reviews—the social proof they create is an invaluable selling point.

questions.passage: Imagine you're trying to decide which of three laptops to purchase online. The first has (A)[few / many] reviews and a (B)[high / low] rating; the second has fewer reviews and a low rating; and the third has no reviews at all. Chances are that you will select the one with the most (C)[dissatisfied / satisfied] customers. This is due to something called social proof, a psychological phenomenon based on the idea that people strive to conform to social norms. Marketers use it to more or less borrow third-party influence in the interest of luring new customers. Shoppers who are undecided about which product to buy are easily swayed by the reviews and recommendations of other people who have bought the items they are considering. This is why companies are so eager to persuade their customers to leave reviews—the social proof they create is an invaluable selling point.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 많은(many) 리뷰와 높은(high) 평점, 그리고 가장 만족한(satisfied) 고객을 가진 상품을 고르게 된다는 내용이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① many — high — satisfied — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② few — high — satisfied (A 반대: 많은→적은)
❌ ③ many — low — satisfied (B 반대: 높은→낮은)
❌ ④ many — high — dissatisfied (C 반대: 만족한→불만족한)

questions.passage: Imagine you're trying to (A)[avoid / decide] which of three laptops to purchase online. The first has many reviews and a high rating; the second has fewer reviews and a low rating; and the third has no reviews at all. Chances are that you will (B)[select / reject] the one with the most satisfied customers. This is due to something called social proof, a psychological phenomenon based on the idea that people strive to conform to social norms. Marketers use it to more or less borrow third-party influence in the interest of luring new customers. Shoppers who are (C)[determined / undecided] about which product to buy are easily swayed by the reviews and recommendations of other people who have bought the items they are considering. This is why companies are so eager to persuade their customers to leave reviews—the social proof they create is an invaluable selling point.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 구매를 결정하려(decide) 하고, 만족한 고객이 많은 상품을 고르며(select), 결정을 못한(undecided) 쇼핑객이 쉽게 흔들린다는 내용이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① avoid — select — undecided (A 반대: 결정하다→피하다)
✅ ② decide — select — undecided — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ decide — reject — undecided (B 반대: 고르다→거부하다)
❌ ④ decide — select — determined (C 반대: 결정 못한→단호한)

questions.passage: Imagine you're trying to decide which of three laptops to purchase online. The first has many reviews and a high rating; the second has fewer reviews and a low rating; and the third has no reviews at all. Chances are that you will select the one with the most satisfied customers. This is due to something called social proof, a psychological phenomenon based on the idea that people strive to conform to social norms. Marketers use it to more or less (A)[lend / borrow] third-party influence in the interest of (B)[luring / repelling] new customers. Shoppers who are undecided about which product to buy are easily swayed by the reviews and recommendations of other people who have bought the items they are considering. This is why companies are so (C)[reluctant / eager] to persuade their customers to leave reviews—the social proof they create is an invaluable selling point.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 마케터는 제3자의 영향력을 빌려(borrow) 신규 고객을 유혹하며(luring), 기업은 리뷰를 남기도록 간절히(eager) 설득한다는 내용이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① lend — luring — eager (A 반대: 빌리다→빌려주다)
❌ ② borrow — repelling — eager (B 반대: 유혹하는→쫓아내는)
✅ ③ borrow — luring — eager — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ borrow — luring — reluctant (C 반대: 간절한→꺼리는)

Marketers use it to more or less ③<u>borrow</u> third-party influence in the interest of luring new customers. Shoppers who are undecided about which product to buy are easily swayed by the reviews and recommendations of other people who have bought the items they are considering. This is why companies are so eager to persuade their customers to leave reviews—the social proof they create is an ④<u>worthless</u> selling point.

det.korean: '가치 없는(worthless)'이 아니라 '매우 귀중한(invaluable)'이 문맥상 적절하다. 기업이 만든 사회적 증거는 귀중한 판매 포인트라는 내용이다.

③ borrow — 빌리다, 원문 일치

This is why companies are so eager to persuade their customers to leave reviews—the social proof they create is an invaluable selling point.
